label: Compass
depicts: Round compass ring with a tilted inner diamond needle at the center
use_when: Use when the interface wants a classic round compass dial with an inner diamond needle.
avoid_when: Do not use for drafting or signpost icons when the outer ring and center needle matter.

label: Compass
depicts: Drafting compass outline with one ring hinge and two long pointed legs
use_when: Use when the interface wants the geometry tool used for drawing circles rather than a map dial.
avoid_when: Do not use for navigation compasses when the two leg drafting tool form is visible.

label: Compass
depicts: Tilted diamond compass marker with an inner crossed needle shape
use_when: Use when the interface wants a compact compass marker without a surrounding ring.
avoid_when: Do not use for the round dial or drafting compass when the diamond body is the cue.

label: Directions
depicts: Signpost outline with two opposite arrow signs on a vertical pole
use_when: Use when the interface wants a wayfinding signpost rather than a compass shaped direction marker.
avoid_when: Do not use for compass icons when the vertical pole and two arrow signs matter.

label: Directions
depicts: Single road sign panel on a short vertical post with a pointed right end
use_when: Use when the interface wants one simple direction sign instead of a full two way signpost.
avoid_when: Do not use for the two arrow signpost when the icon should stay as one right pointed panel.
